basic_details.job_title: ICAR-CIBA Young Professional – II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-CIBA, Chennai has invited applications for one Young Professional –II post on a purely temporary basis under the Central Corpus Fund-Indian Council of Agricultural Research (CCF ICAR) National Priority Project on a recombinase-aided amplification based genetic sex identification method in Pearlspot (Etroplus suratensis). The post pays Rs 42,000/- (consolidated) per month and needs a Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Genetics, Molecular Biology or an equivalent discipline. Applications go through https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 6 December 202

important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated to shortlisted candidates by email

how_to_apply: Download the application form (the prescribed proforma attached to the notice) and type it clearly.
Indicate your experience and skills/instruments used, and give your contact numbers in the proforma. Only the prescribed proforma is accepted.
Sign the filled form and attach all required documents. Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them at the relevant places in the form.
Merge all documents into one PDF file.
Name the file GENETIC_MARKER << Applicant First Name >>06122026.pdf.
Attach the PDF in the application available at https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 06.12.2026.
Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI.
Scan copy of the category certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates.
Scan copy of the NET/GATE certificate, if qualified.
Scan copies of certificates for university awards, medals or conference best presentation awards.
Applications may be rejected if the required documents are not attached.
important_instructions: ICAR-CIBA does not enter into correspondence with applicants who are not called for interview. Director, CIBA reserves the right to accept or reject any applications. The declaration in the form states that candidature is liable to be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process if any information is found false or misleading. Supporting documents must be produced as and when required. The notice prints these institute contacts: phone 044-24618817, 24616948; fax 044-24610311; email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIBA
content_sections.text: ICAR-CIBA is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research located in Chennai. This notification, issued by its administration section, covers one post under a Central Corpus Fund-ICAR National Priority Project. The post is on a purely temporary basis of the institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Master's degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Genetics, Molecular Biology, or an equivalent discipline from a recognized university or institution. Desirable: Experience using the Linux command line and programming in Python and R. Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows and genetic marker discovery. Age: Lower age limit 21 years; upper age limit 45 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates is as per Govt. of India norms. The notice does not print an "as on" date for counting age. The application form asks for details of NET/GATE qualification, SCI journal papers, patents, awards, work experience in project/industry/aquaculture, and the titles and abstracts of postgraduate and PhD theses. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs 42,000/- (consolidated) per month. The engagement is for one year initially and may be extended for a further period of two years, one year at a time, based on satisfactory performance. The notice describes the post as purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIBA Young Professional –II
content_sections.text: Download the application form (the prescribed proforma attached to the notice) and type it clearly. Indicate your experience and skills/instruments used, and give your contact numbers in the proforma. Only the prescribed proforma is accepted. Sign the filled form and attach all required documents. Number the supporting documents serially as Annexures and refer to them at the relevant places in the form. Merge all documents into one PDF file. Name the file GENETIC_MARKER << Applicant First Name >>06122026.pdf. Attach the PDF in the application available at https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 06.12.2026. Degree certificates, experience certificates and research papers DOI. Scan copy of the category certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates. Scan copy of the NET/GATE certificate, if qualified. Scan copies of certificates for university awards, medals or conference best presentation awards. Applications may be rejected if the required documents are not attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Communication is sent only to shortlisted candidates for the interview. The date and time will be intimated to them by email. The interview mode is physical mode or a suitable online platform. Candidates who receive the mail should appear for the online or offline interview at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai, with the required documents. The notice does not describe how marks or shortlisting are decided.
